New Soi Fon Doujin by Lime. Currently working on a translation of the recent Rangiku one they made. Will start on this after.

Lime's Note:
This time I drew Soi Fon from Bleach. It is based on the previously released "Erocos Dream 20," with the story reworked and in manga form.

The costume used is a green track uniform just like in the CG, but the racing bloomers are slightly higher cut. Also, the hairstyle is different from the previous one, and is based on her TYBW style, which I personally prefer.

The storyline is almost the same as in the CG, and is inspired by the relationship Soi Fon and Yoruichi had before the reconciled. I liked Soi Fon the most when she first appeared, and was all cocky.

I have produced several doujin so far, but still feel like an amateur when it comes to drawing in manga style, so i would like to continue improving my skills.
